newsitem.title: USA: Medaphis said up on rumors of takeover.
newsitem.headline: Medaphis said up on rumors of takeover.

text.p: Shares of Medaphis Corp jumped Wednesday on rumors of a possible takeover by HBO & Co, traders and analysts said.
The possible deal values Medaphis at about $20 to $22 a share, they said.
HBO & Co and Medaphis declined to comment on the rumors.
Medaphis' stock gained 2-1/16 to 13-5/8 in afternoon trading. HBO's dropped 3/4 to 62-3/8.
"There's rumors of a potential buyout," said Jason Rosenbluth, an analyst at Volpe, Welty & Co. "They're seen as a good takeout candidate."

Said Scott Remley, an analyst with Robinson-Humphrey: "The rumors have intensified this week, with HBO leading the list of possible buyers. But there are a number of players out there who could be a good fit."
National Data Corp was also cited as a potential suitor, but the company declined to comment on market speculation.

Medaphis's stock has faced pressure since August when the company said its near-term earnings would be hurt by weakness in its Medaphis Physician Services Corp unit and the reorganization of the Imonics unit.
Investors filed class action lawsuits against the company in August, alleging that Medaphis mispresented material facts about its reengineering and consolidation efforts.
Medaphis, which provides billing, accounts receivable and management services to the health care industry, also recently agreed to amend the terms of its credit facility and restrict cash dividends.

Medaphis' stock was one of the most heavily traded Nasdaq issues on Wednesday, with about 7.28 million shares changing hands. There also was heavier-than-average trading in Medaphis' February and March call options, said Harrison Roth, Cowen & Co's senior options strategist.
"That might be a play that someone may buy them," Roth said.
Call option gives investors the right to buy a specific number of shares at a specified price by a fixed date. Investors often buy calls on takeover rumors or when a stock price is expected to rise.
Medaphis' options have been busier than usual recently, with a notable increase starting on Tuesday, traders said.
Options volume on Tuesday was 4,940, compared with 1,690 average daily volume, one trader said.

"Definitely it looks like some sort of a leak -- not that we have a takeover over yet -- but I would definitely say there was leak of some sort -- or at least talks or something going on. We'll probably never know," said one options trader.
